stories.title: After 15-year delay, BMC clears 27 structures for road widening in Kandivali
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Tuesday demolished 27 structures that had been obstructing a long-pending road-widening project at the Mathuradas Road-Swami Vivekanand Road junction in Kandivali West. The demolition drive was carried out by the civic body's R-South Ward under its 'Pedestrian First' campaign, which aims to make footpaths more accessible to pedestrians by removing encroachments and clearing roads.

stories.title: Man arrested for allegedly killing acquaintance over unpaid mobile loan
stories.summary: A man allegedly killed his 23-year-old acquaintance following a dispute over unpaid mobile loan instalments and dumped the body in bushes at a village in Navi Mumbai, police said on Wednesday. Officials said that the incident occurred last week. They also added that the accused, identified as Pratik Mohan Jadhav (30), a resident of Panvel in Navi Mumbai, was arrested on Monday, as per PTI.

stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. stories.title: Mumbai’s First Underground Toilet-Cum-Art Gallery Planned at Kala Ghoda; BMC Approves ₹24-Crore Project
stories.summary: In a move to improve pedestrian movement and preserve the heritage character of South Mumbai, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has given in-principle approval to develop an underground public facility near Lion Gate in Kala Ghoda. stories.title: Mumbai: Five bikers arrested for performing dangerous stunts on WEH
stories.summary: Mumbai Police have arrested five bikers for allegedly performing dangerous stunts, driving recklessly and creating a public nuisance on the Western Express Highway (WEH) . stories.title: Mumbai car dealer's trade certificate suspended over Ferrari delivery
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Transport Department has suspended the trade certificate of a Mumbai-based car dealer for 30 days for allegedly handing over a Ferrari to a customer before completing the vehicle’s registration, officials said on Wednesday. According to the Transport Commissioner’s office, a Navnit Motors outlet in Bandra delivered a red Ferrari to its owner on October 13, before completing its registration formalities, in violation of prescribed rules.

stories.title: Prince William & Kate Middleton Visit Chanakya School Of Craft In Mumbai's Lower Parel - VIDEO
stories.summary: Mumbai: Prince William and Kate Middleton visited the Chanakya School of Craft in Lower Parel on Wednesday, putting the spotlight on India's rich textile heritage and sustainable fashion. stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. stories.title: Missing three-year-old boy found dead in Andheri drain after three-day search
stories.summary: The body of a three-year-old boy, who had gone missing from the DN Nagar area on November 14, was found floating in a drain in Andheri West on Tuesday, bringing a tragic end to the search for the child. stories.title: Dawood Ibrahim's Ancestral Home In Mumbai's Bhendi Bazaar To Be Demolished By BMC | Video
stories.summary: Mumbai: A building in south Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar, identified as the ancestral home of fugitive underworld figure Dawood Ibrahim, was partially demolished by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday. stories.title: Shivaji Maharaj’s Historic Vagh Nakh Goes on Display at Mumbai Museum
stories.summary: Mumbaikars can now witness the historic Vagh Nakh (tiger claw weapon) associated with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his legendary encounter with Afzal Khan in 1659. stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Mangaluru reported a bird hit on arrival at Navi Mumbai International Airport on Tuesday, following which the aircraft was grounded for inspection, a PTI source said.
